REST API for the Kubeflow Pipelines platform (v2beta1). Provides programmatic access to manage experiments, pipelines, pipeline versions, runs, and recurring jobs on a Kubeflow Pipelines deployment. Authentication is handled by the Kubeflow distribution and is typically a bearer token or session cookie passed in request headers.
